text: The Gnosis ICO shows how a reverse dutch auction can mitigate the inefficiencies and risks of a capped sale: the offering was capped at $12.5 million and the time needed to complete the sale determined the quantity of tokens distributed to investors, with the rest held by the start-up team.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags

abstract: To mitigate the inefficiencies and the risks of a capped sale, the Gnosis ICO was structured as a reverse dutch auction
